exam: 103年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 觀光英語
classes: 觀光行政(選試觀光英語)

essays.text: 請用英文解釋說明下列名詞：（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）Tourist trapBackpackingBoutique hotelInbound tourism vs. Outbound tourism

請用英文回答下列各題：（每小題 6 分，共 36 分）Please list down the names of six well-known adventure sports in the world.Please list down six reasons why people like to travel.What is“hospitality marketing”? What are skills needed to develop a successfulhospitality-marketing strategy?Please list down 4 passenger security regulations commonly practiced in internationalairports.Please list down six pieces of booking information you should provide at the time whenyou make theatre reservations.Please design and describe a Bus Sightseeing Tour of Taipei (or any other city) fortourists.

翻譯：請將下列英文譯成中文；中文譯成英文。（每小題 6 分，共 24 分）The Ifugao（伊富高）rice terraces in the northern Philippines are considered theworld’s eighth wonder. Long plagued by erosion caused by earthworms, this UNESCOWorld Heritage site now faces a more dangerous threat: tourism. Tourism hasencouraged the commercial production of woodcarving. This has depleted local forestresources.A radical breakthrough in aviation technology could lead to the development of aircraftcapable of entering and re-entering the Earth’s atmosphere. By orbiting at 300kilometres above the Earth’s surface, the aircraft could be capable of flying betweenLondon and Sydney, Australia, in a little over one hour.國際咖啡組織（ICO）在四月報告中指出，國際咖啡均價已達兩年高點。主要產地巴西乾旱，及可能出現的聖嬰現象，將進一步影響咖啡產量。在美國華盛頓的醫療保健協會（the Health Association, Washington），明文規定五月二十六日起實施的夏季便服政策嚴禁「橡膠人字拖或任何走路時發出聲響的拖鞋」。

作文：請就以下題目撰寫一篇短文（200-250 字），評量項目包括內容、組織、文法、用字遣詞。（20 分）The Hohaiyan Rock Festival（貢寮國際海洋音樂祭）is an annual Taiwan rock musicfestival held in Fulong Beach, Gongliao, New Taipei city, Taiwan. This year the festival isto be held from July 9th to 13th. I would like you to design and describe a one-weekmusical package tour for international tourists.
